$comment: SEC-5: high/critical advisories accepted after review, checked by scripts/check-audit.mjs. Every entry needs a reason and an expiry; an expired entry, or one npm no longer reports, fails CI. Never add an entry to turn CI green without reading the advisory.

advisories.reason: Docusaurus core's static-generation worker pool (tinypool@1, pinned by @docusaurus/core 3.10.2; the fix is tinypool 2, a major). Exploitation needs an attacker-controlled worker option or a prior prototype-pollution primitive in the build process; the build only renders this repository's own content. Build-time only, never shipped to the browser.
Same package and path as GHSA-5gmw-xhrv-c9v3: a prototype-pollution gadget in run() options, reachable only from inputs the build controls. Build-time only.

Via copy-webpack-plugin and css-minimizer-webpack-plugin inside @docusaurus/bundler (serialize-javascript@6; the fix is 7.0.5, a major). The RCE needs attacker-crafted RegExp/Date objects to be serialized; both plugins serialize only build options written in this repository. Build-time only.
